Rust lacks the external CLI client and cli/{status,open,prompt,poll,cancel} door endpoints; a user cannot list teammates/status or stream turns from the CLI.
Windows-only behaviour: retries transient Windows AV/indexer file-lock errors (EBUSY/EPERM/EACCES); Rust also keeps one open handle per run.
try_list_recent silently skips unreadable ledger files with no unreadableCount; the sidebar/history header cannot warn a user about broken history files.
LedgerWriter::line has no fit_event_to_ledger shortening; an oversized runtime field (>512 KiB) aborts the run instead of being trimmed.
try_list_recent reads one file at a time (bounding open FDs below 16) and lists the newest 40 past 2,000 files; only Node's >1 pool peak check does not apply.
read_storage_report has no per-file (size, mtime) cache and re-parses every ledger on each call, making Settings storage measurement slow on large histories.
discover_one has no binary/shim (size, mtime) cache for --version and --help, so every launch/refresh re-probes all CLI binaries and slows discovery.
Normalizer::finish already turns OpenCode auto-rejecting stderr for bash/edit/write/patch and external_directory into the exact refusal messages; tests are missing.
agents::discover_one runs version, capability, models, and readiness probes sequentially so slow CLIs take the sum of probe times instead of overlapping.
agents::discover blocks until all probe threads join and emits no incremental started/finished updates while slow runtimes are checking.
Windows-only behaviour: tests cmd.exe and .cmd launcher quoting.

opencode_events::Normalizer reads raw p["cost"] instead of listed step/tier prices, so own models miss tiered or listed costs.

Codex skills/extraRoots/set, OpenCode skills.paths/external_directory, Copilot --plugin-dir, and Antigravity --add-dir are all wired.
